integrity: The theorem is proved from exact failure-probability formulas, integer superadditivity, and a parametric polynomial nonnegativity certificate. Finite-field Markov computations are supplementary checks only.
limitations: Systematic two-file codes of total information dimension three with exactly one mixed nonzero column. The proof does not cover two or more mixed columns or higher-dimensional residual cases. Literature search cannot prove absolute novelty.
title: Dimension-three one-mixed-column hyperbolic bound
